summary_en: 1,540,900 ordinary shares to be cancelled; 0.55% of shares outstanding ex-treasury. Effective 2026-08-07. Post-cancellation issued shares (including treasury): 280,570,991.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 30 July 2026, Nisshin Seifun Group Inc. (TSE Prime, code 2002) announced that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 1,540,900 ordinary shares held in treasury, effective 8 August 2026, under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares to be cancelled represent 0.55% of issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Following the cancellation, total issued shares including treasury will be 280,570,991.
